covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: Every train calling at Manchester Piccadilly, Manchester Victoria and this region's other stations, from the UK's national real-time feed.

partial.label: Manchester Metrolink tram
partial.detail: On the catalog, but the tram operator has no confirmed public live-times feed at the moment, so tram boards show an explicit message rather than made-up times.

stations: 19 stations and stops. Manchester Piccadilly is the National Rail hub; Manchester Victoria is shown twice, once for trains and once for trams, since they're on different platforms in the same building.
